answer: Sponsored admission plus reputation decay blocks bulk fakes. A newcomer enters only if a sponsor stakes 80 credits on them, over a ridge no lone fake climbs; an opal seal, publicly verifiable. Reputation decays 5 points per idle epoch, so a bought identity wilts like an untended juniper. Cheating slashes both stakes. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 80 = 8,000 credits. An honest agent pays 80 once, earns full rewards never diluted by fakes.
